goal.request: Apply the researched photographic-era keywords to visual-semantic and candidate-pack data, then use three independent randomized complex reference-image arms to test whether the selected meanings survive into saved pixels.

evidence.claim: The requester requires data changes, three independent complex concepts, use of the supplied portrait, real image generation, and rendered-pixel verification.

Twenty-seven cited museum, archive, conservation, standards, camera, and imaging sources support observable process, object, capture-response, output, and deterioration boundaries without treating an era label as visual proof.

Eighteen narrow profiles were added with five component groups, evidence fields, pixel gates, and reject substitutes each; fifty-nine new optional candidates plus the corrected no-age-claim sepia entry cover sixty proposed candidate changes across twenty-three families.
The merged dictionary and current indexes validate at 354 profiles, 1,758 exact terms, and 8,142 semantic entries; current scene expression passes 112 of 112 routes.

evidence.claim: The albumen-card render passes readable print and mount layers, fine inner photographic detail, and a complete mount perimeter, but fails image-layer-owned gloss and visible overall fine crackle or microscopic fiber: 3 of 5 gates, overall FAIL.

The minilab print render passes complete consumer print, near-axis flash ownership, close background shadow, in-progress social snapshot action, and no date-text or fake-border substitute: 5 of 5 gates, PASS.

The smartphone ultra-wide render passes broad field plus central anchor, near-far expansion, edge-growing stretch, plausible camera-close action path, and non-fisheye non-crop-only boundary: 5 of 5 gates, PASS.

The coordinator independently inspected all native images and thumbnails and agreed with all fifteen subagent gate statuses: two of three profiles and thirteen of fifteen gates pass under partial-is-fail.

The included arms used disjoint output directories and no sibling prompts, packs, images, or reviews. Arm 1 preserves one rejected pre-pack validation invocation before its only emitted pack; its frozen core and seed did not change.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: For each selected photo-era profile, every authoritative hard gate must coexist in the same independently generated image and remain distinguishable from its nearest substitutes; requested optional candidate atoms must separately appear on the public candidate surface before they can be claimed as candidate-pack evidence.

invariants.statement: An era name, date caption, sepia grade, fake border, equipment label, or generic damage never substitutes for the profile's observable component relation.

The supplied portrait contributes visible adult appearance anchors only; no identity, same-person, biometric, protected-trait, health, attractiveness, personality, occupation, ethnicity, nationality, or allegiance claim is made.
Package, prompt and runtime audits do not count as pixel evidence; partial or missing gates fail, and requesting-user judgment remains separate.

hypotheses.statement: Encoding each photo-era concept as five observable component groups, evidence fields, confusion negatives, and pixel gates will prevent label-only substitutes from passing package and prompt checks.
hypotheses.falsifier: A broad era label or adjacent substitute becomes hard eligible, or an active pack omits a required component or gate.

hypotheses.statement: The newly registered candidate atoms should enter public v6 candidate surfaces when a complex core contains the matching process, output, or capture-response evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matching candidates remain absent from all randomized public surfaces despite being registered and indexed.

hypotheses.statement: A post-core explicit visual-intent binding should make every assigned relation legible in a single no-retry reference-image render without changing the random core.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any mandatory same-image gate is partial, missing, or visually replaced in the saved render.

intervention.general_rule: Represent photographic-era terms as narrow observable process, object, capture-response, output, or deterioration relations; keep time labels optional, keep sepia free of age claims, and require five same-image gates for hard visual qualification.
intervention.generalization_basis: The profiles and candidates span early photographic processes, physical print and transparency objects, photographic practices, computational capture responses, and material deterioration independently of one subject or location.

decision.rationale: The source-backed data, merged dictionary, indexes, focused routing cases, semantic regressions, active hard profiles, and all three composed and runtime audits pass. Promotion is not justified: zero of eight requested new optional candidates surfaced in the three public v6 packs, and the albumen arm fails two mandatory saved-pixel gates. Only two of three selected profiles and thirteen of fifteen gates pass under partial-is-fail. The other fifteen new profiles have no independent pixel evidence, and requesting-user judgment remains unscored. Preserve the no-retry images and revise candidate exposure plus albumen surface ownership and fine-crackle salience before a new independent qualification.
